summary: The HIGH finding from round 1 (attribute-name injection via crafted key containing quote/angle/whitespace) is now covered by explicit regex validation and explicit tests. _SAFE_ATTR_NAME_RE rejects: empty string, leading digit, whitespace, newline, angle bracket, quote, and any non-[A-Za-z0-9_-] character. isinstance(key, str) check prevents AttributeError/TypeError on non-string keys (defence-in-depth for pathological upstream input). No new attack surface introduced. All three hardening layers from Decision 1 remain intact. No logging of dropped payloads.
